name: V3.0.0a1 Application Platform Source Completion
objective: Advance Company UI from a governed component framework to an additive application platform without regressing inherited v2 UI/UX, runtime or certification contracts.
implemented: additive ApplicationRuntime and WorkspaceRuntime ownership kernel over the frozen v2 renderer/design laws
typed namespaced state with atomic transactions, defensive reads, revision history and exact rollback
transaction-level undo/redo with absent-vs-None fidelity and stale-redo invalidation
unified Dataset/DataSession engine shared by rows, grouped visual series and KPI metrics
semantic filtering/search/sort/paging/grouping with exact row identity and lazy equality/membership indexes
adaptive governed workspace grid with deterministic collision handling, responsive derivation, compaction and snapshot restore
application/workspace JSON snapshot persistence for runtime state, panel geometry and shared data-session filters
semantic visualization planning that reuses the certified chart renderer stack and shared cross-filter sessions
governed extension registry for components, data sources, commands, visualizations and workspace panels
runtime diagnostics for lifecycle/task, command-performance, panel and extension ownership
all RC5 lifecycle, async, DataTable persistence/editing, overlay, chart and pathological-data hardening retained
v2 UI rendering remains opt-in migration only; existing route/component visual anatomy is not globally replaced
claim_boundary: Source-complete alpha. No claim of live target/runtime/browser/human visual certification is made from this sandbox.
